# SiteStudio

SiteStudio is a web development studio run by Viktor Seto, a web developer and AI Solutions Architect based in Brussels, Belgium.

## What we do

- Build landing pages, business websites and web applications
- Use modern technologies: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Integrate backends with Supabase/PostgreSQL
- Add payments with Stripe
- Implement AI integrations (Gemini, OpenAI)
- Include SEO fundamentals in every project

## Service packages

See `/pricing.md` for detailed pricing.

## Target markets

- Lithuania
- Belgium
- Worldwide remote clients
